IPT.evidence_source: The section describes a correlational study investigating the relationship between family environment and child depression, but does not mention any intervention or therapy type (CBT or IPT).

male_pct.evidence_source: The section does not provide any demographic information about the participants' gender.

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/10/Text/7] The fifth goal of Study 1 was to investigate the relationship between the child's depression and family environment. Specifically, we expected that children who were from lower cohesion and higher conflict families, who were often verbally or physically punished by parents, and who received less parental attention would be more depressed. All of these hypotheses were strongly supported.
